name: contract-check
description: Contract Check Tahap 1: deteksi dampak perubahan kontrak API antar repo, jalan lokal.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev -w @cc/server" "npm run dev -w @cc/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cc/shared && npm run build -w @cc/server && npm run build -w @cc/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
